replies.author: @GLOBALLIFE26
replies.text: Hello! Thank you for sharing your thoughts. The $0.50–$1.50 daily income estimate is based on poverty metrics from international agencies like the UN and World Bank, particularly for vulnerable households in rural areas. However, economic conditions can vary across different provinces. If you have updated local figures or additional context, we’d love to hear your insight! 🙏
